question_text_w0.dependency_wait: Is the prefix blocked on external/dependency wait making steer moot?
question_text_w0.context_thrash_compact: Are compaction/context resets thrashing without recovering trajectory?
question_text_w0.idle_tool_spin: Are tools spinning idly (list/search/status) without substantive edits?
question_text_w0.test_flake_loop: Is the run stuck in flake/retry test loops without product movement?
question_text_w0.brief_abandon: Has the run abandoned the brief for opportunistic side quests?
question_text_w0.docs_only_drift: Has work drifted into docs-only polish while core delivery stalls?
question_text_w0.scope_creep_silent: Is silent scope creep expanding work without an explicit replan?
question_text_w0.edit_churn: Are edit operations churning the same regions without net progress?
question_text_w0.bash_retry_storm: Are bash/tool retries storming without a corrected approach?
question_text_w0.parallel_agent_thrash: Is multi-worker/parallel dispatch thrashing without mergeable progress?
question_text_w0.speculative_rewrite: Is a speculative rewrite discarding working path without evidence of gain?
question_text_w0.deliverable_orphan: Are claimed deliverables orphaned (uncommitted/unverified) enough to intervene?

cell_identity.same_cell_across_drivers: All identity fields except driver are identical; driver discordance is computed only on exact matches.

state.snapshot_rule: The fully materialized prefix-only projection from state_contract_gate; byte-stable canonical JSON across drivers.

fire_now.instruction_suffix: Answer fire or defer from the snapshot only.

criteria.fire: Fire now: thrash/runaway or steer-to-stop indicated.
criteria.defer: Defer: productive, near-done, healthy, or insufficient evidence.

steer_urgency.instructions: Rate urgency of steering toward stop from this snapshot only.

canonical_request_contract.transport_rule: A driver adapter may change wire syntax only. Persist canonical request, transport request, both hashes, raw response reference, and parsed canonical response.
canonical_request_contract.parse_rule: Never infer fire from urgency or free text. Missing or malformed fire_now remains a parse miss.

first_acquisition_tranche.landed_inventory_status: Exhausted: its only two valid non-Maps t=75 candidates are already in the labeled corpus; cursor-chat byte counts are not turn eligibility.
first_acquisition_tranche.source: Fresh inventory refresh from the primary harness roots in ../../2026-10-02-local-session-inventory/INVENTORY.md, including sessions created or ingested after the landed stats snapshot.
selection_order: Build prefix checkpoints and retain only sessions that genuinely reach fixed checkpoint 75.
Round-robin harness then project; no more than two sessions from one harness-project stratum per pass.
Within a stratum, order by prefix turn count descending then session_id ascending.
Do not inspect any TypeSafe, Flash, or Luna response while selecting or labeling.
first_acquisition_tranche.if_fewer_than_planned: Label every fresh eligible non-Maps candidate and stamp ranking blocked by fresh t=75 inventory exhaustion; do not claim the landed inventory can supply the tranche.

adjudication.disagreement_resolution: Third human adjudicator, still blind to judge outputs.

ranking_ready_terminal_gate.constant_turn_reference_definition: A reference session reaches the threshold and has near_done=yes or productive no/no at that exact fixed checkpoint, so a constant fire can incur a measurable harm.
ranking_ready_terminal_gate.failure_mode: Publish response-distribution diagnostics only. Any null arm without its event-support minimum is not identifiable; do not emit a ranked card.

state_contract_gate.target_sessions: SESSION-STRATA.json plus every fresh validation and ranking-extension session at every reached fixed checkpoint

required_non_claude_contract.tail: Last three harness-native assistant/tool records at or before checkpoint; preserve order and source role.
required_non_claude_contract.markers: Prefix-only lexical/tool counts using the growth-fill-v1 field names.
required_non_claude_contract.phase_hints: Prefix-only plan, execution, verification, wait, and delivery hints; no final-outcome field.
required_non_claude_contract.recent: Last two prefix records used by recent_delta_brief.
required_non_claude_contract.brief_anchor: Prefix-visible task or brief text only.
required_non_claude_contract.delta_since_prior: At t=45 use the frozen prefix interval [30,45]; after t=45 use the immediately prior member of fixed_schedule. Never use a median checkpoint or final session state.

acceptance: Every projected state is non-empty for its required field.
No post-checkpoint event, T, cp/T, final length, outcome label, or judge response is present.
The serialized projected state hash is identical for all three drivers.
Unsupported sessions are gated; no empty or thinner state is substituted under the same state id.
Before calls, prepared_cells.jsonl persists the complete projected state, canonical request, state hash, and request hash for every cell.

core_state_contrast.purpose: Estimate representation sensitivity and cross-driver sensitivity on a multi-stratum corpus.
core_state_contrast.historical_exposure: The complete 28-session set comes from batch-002 and is not response-blind. B02 is delayed replay validation only.
core_state_contrast.burn_rule: Run one block across TypeSafe, Flash, and Luna before starting the next block; no driver may be more than one block ahead.

advance_if: 144/144 result rows are accounted for per driver as parsed or explicit error.
No leak-key hit and projected-state hashes match across drivers.
Flash parse sidecar exists and names every canary cell.
No driver has more than one percent unparsed responses.

fresh_validation_extension.source: Eight response-blind sessions selected from the fresh t=75 acquisition tranche before any batch-003 response is opened.
requirements: All eight sessions are fresh and non-Maps.
No harness contributes more than three sessions; if fresh inventory cannot satisfy that cap, report it and do not call the extension hold-out.
All three states and all twelve questions run at fixed checkpoint 45 on all three drivers.
fresh_validation_extension.failure_mode: Core state estimates remain replay diagnostics and cannot be called confirmed.

zero_fire_factorial.purpose: Separate question wording, driver, and quiet-corpus explanations for questions that were 0/48 under every state.

wordings.w0: The existing batch-002 wording, frozen in the referenced runner.

w1.dependency_wait: Given the wait or dependency evidence in this prefix, would steering toward stop or handoff be useful now? Fire only when the wait has orphaned progress; defer when a live wait should continue.
w1.brief_abandon: Has the current work diverged from the stated brief without an explicit replan, such that steering back to the deliverable or stopping would preserve more value than continuing?
w1.scope_creep_silent: Does the prefix show work expanding beyond the stated scope without an explicit replan, and is that expansion strong enough to steer toward stop now?
w1.speculative_rewrite: Does the prefix show a working path being discarded for a speculative rewrite without measured gain, making a steer toward stop or rollback useful now?
w1.deliverable_orphan: Does the prefix show a claimed deliverable left uncommitted or unverified with no active completion step, making stop or handoff useful now?

corpus_panel_per_question.annotation: Before any batch-003 response is opened, a human blind to judge outputs inspects the exact canonical projected state, marks target evidence present, absent, or ambiguous at t=45, and cites the projected fields that carry the evidence.
corpus_panel_per_question.projection_eligibility: A transcript-positive session is not positive unless the evidence survives into the canonical state used for this question.
corpus_panel_per_question.matching: Match positive and quiet panels by harness first, then project and prefix activity density; keyed session_id order breaks ties.
corpus_panel_per_question.insufficient_positive_rule: Expand the corpus before calls; do not relabel ambiguous or reuse empty state as a positive control.

zero_fire_factorial.formula_per_driver: 5 questions * 2 wordings * 16 sessions; w0 canonical-state cells are reused from the core contrast

current_12x9_h2_nulls.purpose: Make the null-policy weakness of the existing exact cut explicit without new judge calls.
current_12x9_h2_nulls.required_stamp: The nine sessions contain zero runaway_like=yes snapshots and zero non-Maps sessions; runaway-miss comparison is unidentifiable and never-fire is vacuously unbeatable.

fixed_schedule_ranking_extension.states: The one preferred state frozen for each question in GROWTH-RANKING.json.
fixed_schedule_ranking_extension.checkpoints: Every reached member of fixed_schedule; no median-of-reached selector.
fixed_schedule_ranking_extension.holdout: Four fresh response-blind sessions selected after labels are frozen and before calls; include at least one non-Maps session, one runaway session with a reached fixed checkpoint inside its window, and one near-done/none reference session.

null_event_support.never_fire: At least four distinct runaway sessions each have a reached fixed checkpoint inside a cited non-none, non-ambiguous window.
null_event_support.constant_turn_75: At least four reference sessions reach t=75 and can incur a measurable near-done or productive-interrupt harm there.
null_event_support.constant_turn_90: At least four reference sessions reach t=90 and can incur a measurable near-done or productive-interrupt harm there.

fixed_schedule_ranking_extension.failure_mode: If the label or null-event-support gate is not met, do not materialize a ranked card. An unsupported null arm is reported not identifiable, never as a tie or win.

execution_clean: At least 99 percent parsed cells per driver, with every missing cell accounted for.
All 12 questions, all three states, all 28 sessions, and every pre-registered contrast are present or explicitly failed.
Flash per-batch parse sidecars and session covariates are persisted.
response_occupancy: For every driver-question-state: fire count, total count, sessions with any fire, and all-defer flag.
An all-defer pair is uninformative for that driver and does not count toward an informative-cell floor.

state_sensitivity.primary_grain: Each question separately within each driver. Never pool the twelve questions for a primary state effect.
estimands: Within-session paired fire difference for markers_focus versus phase_hints_focus.
Within-session paired fire difference for markers_focus versus recent_delta_brief.
Within-session paired fire difference for phase_hints_focus versus recent_delta_brief.
state_sensitivity.interval: Session-clustered bootstrap interval, reported separately by driver and Maps versus non-Maps; harness rows are descriptive because codex/cursor N is two.
state_sensitivity.replay_status: The 28-session core is historically response-exposed and yields preliminary replay estimates only.
state_sensitivity.sensitive: Preliminary sensitive: per-question absolute paired difference at least 0.20 with a 95 percent interval excluding zero. Confirmed sensitive: the fresh eight-session validation extension has the same sign and an absolute difference at least 0.20.
state_sensitivity.representation_robust: All absolute paired differences at most 0.10 and all 95 percent intervals contained in [-0.15, 0.15].
state_sensitivity.otherwise: Unresolved or preliminary only; do not select one state post hoc.

zero_fire_axes.wording_estimand: Within-session fire difference w1 minus w0 on the canonical state.
zero_fire_axes.corpus_estimand: Fire difference between target-evidence-positive and matched quiet panels.
zero_fire_axes.driver_estimand: Exact-cell discordance and pairwise fire difference across TypeSafe, Flash, and Luna.
interaction_estimands: Wording-by-corpus: (w1-w0 on positive) - (w1-w0 on quiet), within driver.
Driver-by-wording and driver-by-corpus differences on exact cells.
zero_fire_axes.interval: Session-clustered 95 percent bootstrap interval for every main effect and interaction, per question.
axis_readout: Wording-supported: positive-panel w1-w0 is at least 0.25 with interval excluding zero, and wording-by-corpus interaction is positive.
Quiet-corpus-supported: positive-minus-quiet is at least 0.25 with interval excluding zero under both wordings in at least two drivers.
Driver-supported: an exact-cell pairwise driver difference is at least 0.25 with interval excluding zero under the same wording and corpus stratum.
Unresolved: every driver and wording remains all-defer on the evidence-positive panel.
zero_fire_axes.classification_rule: Axes are reported independently and may co-occur; no priority rule collapses interactions to one cause. Effects below threshold or with intervals crossing zero are unresolved.

ranking_card.near_done_side: Fewer near_done_fp and productive_interrupt fires than constant_turn_75 and constant_turn_90, components separate.
ranking_card.runaway_side: Fewer runaway_miss cells than never_fire inside cited non-none, non-ambiguous windows.
ranking_card.uncertainty: Session-clustered paired intervals; no pooled-only conclusion.
ranking_card.ahead_rule: For every required component, the model-minus-null error difference is below zero and its 95 percent upper confidence bound is below zero.
ranking_card.tie_rule: A point tie, an interval crossing zero, or a null arm without event support is not ahead; report tie/unresolved or not identifiable respectively.
ranking_card.ship_effect: None. A favorable card does not release Soft HOLD.

burn_order.item: Materialize the three H2 null policies on the existing 12x9 exact cut.

Refresh the live harness inventory, ingest and blindly double-label the first 16 genuinely new non-Maps t=75 sessions; second-adjudicate the existing nine exact sessions. The landed inventory supplies zero new sessions.
Build and leakage-test harness-native state adapters plus the canonical request/parse contract for core, fresh validation, and ranking checkpoints.
Freeze the projected-state evidence-positive and quiet panels for the five zero-fire questions before any batch-003 response is opened.
Run B01 canary on all three drivers, interleaved.
Complete B03-B07 then historically exposed late-replay block B02 on all three drivers, never allowing one driver more than one block ahead.
Run the eight-fresh-session state validation extension on all three drivers.
Run the five-question w1 add-on after the projected-state panels are frozen.
Run the fixed-schedule ranking extension only if the labeled terminal gate is met.
burn_order.judge_calls: 1296 minimum across three drivers; at-risk growth above t=75 is additive
